system.description:
Spend a Hope to prepare a hidden exit
where you're currently standing, such
as a service corridor, blind camera
angle,or pre-planned extraction path.
Until your next rest you can spend a
Hope to trigger the exit plan.
When you do, you immediately move to
the prepared exit or to a safe position
within Very Close range of it, become !
Hidden, and this protocol ends.
This movement must follow a route
that could plausibly exist in the fiction.
